facts.text: Často roste poblíž stájí, na loukách a na trávnících.
facts.quote: Frequently found near stables, as well as in meadows and lawns

facts.text: Často roste mezi kopřivami, které také mají rády půdu bohatou na živiny.
facts.quote: The mushroom is often found growing with nettles (a plant that also likes nutrient-rich soil).

facts.text: Voní po mandlích nebo marcipánu kvůli látce benzaldehydu.
facts.quote: Its odor is similar to that of almond extract or marzipan, due to the presence of benzaldehyde.
It tends to stain yellow on bruising.

facts.text: Klobouk měří na šířku 7 až 20 centimetrů.
facts.quote: The cap is 7–20 cm (3–8 in) across
